regions.merged_text: Jacob W. Julich (52) 9039 Brydn Ave. - baptized Catholic Confirmed away from church over 30 years. He had given up practice of reli- gion as a German soldier - Experienced in politics - sub-marine expert during war - has patents ... May 11th had serious accident, breaking three ribs etc. His mother who had died when he was a baby 9 months old appeared very vividly holding rosary in her hands she said nothing but her atitude imprest him.

regions.merged_text: Patrick Cabrey 38, 5618 - 14 st Detroit now quite recovered from accident September 19th last year. ( 1928) Working for a "wrecking Company" was thrown 150 feet in air coming down head-first on pile of brick and slate rubbish. Falling chimney had struck scant- ling on which he stood sending him in air ... Bleeding and blind and semi-conscious asked nurse sister in St. Joseph's to phone mon- astery and enroll him in S. Mass Assoc'n, which she did and immedi- ately bleeding stops.
